objective: 按『幫助中文讀者閱讀』重新整理目前館藏。前台分類以作品/閱讀目的為主，不以資料來源、檔案格式或原始語言分館。

canonicalNow.confirmed: 目前 canonical 目錄明確只有 zh 分支；已確認 CLSC pre-1931 批次 46 Works。

bulkAcquired.confirmed: 已有大量外文/多語 acquisition manifests，包含 PRDL、Open Christian Data、CatholicCorpus、EEBO-TCP、Corpus Corporum、Biblissima/IIIF、Gallica、Vatican/Bodleian 等。
bulkAcquired.rule: 這些是待 canonical thinning/admission 的資源池，不把 source record/document/volume 數直接當書局藏書數。

candidate.rule: 已攝取但 admission 未完成的作品單獨保持 candidate，不混入正式館藏計數。

currentEvidence: existing Chinese candidates such as 靈歷集光 after admission

includes: general literature in admitted historical Christian collections

readerFacingFamilies.presentation: secondary browse family; do not let reference records overwhelm ordinary reading works

separateFromDawnReadingCollection.reason: 聖經正文及各語言聖經譯本不進黎明書局即時外譯中產品。
既有規劃中 Bible-world / commentary / Scripture-study resources 應與普通書局閱讀館藏分離，供 ONE/聖經世界相關能力使用；不要因 PRDL/OpenChristianData 規模巨大而重新灌回黎明書局。
Christian art/IIIF 圖像若不是一個可閱讀 Work/Edition 的書影或正文載體，不作為黎明書局書籍本體計數。
dataset rows/tokens/reference fragments 不是 books；只有能解析為 Work/Edition/reading resource 的部分才提升。

tradition.role: 次級 facet，不作互斥主分類

values: 中文原作/既有合法中文文本

tier1: 可合法取得全文的外文 books/long-form works
tier3: fragmentary dataset records requiring Work reconstruction
admissionPriority.hardRule: Bible Scripture text and Bible translations never enter translation admission regardless of scale.

sourceSpecificSorting.PRDL: First split out Bible/scripture-study/commentary/reference-only material; canonicalize eligible theology, history, sermons and long-form works by Work identity across 110668 title records and 149839 volume records.
sourceSpecificSorting.OpenChristianData: Do not treat 805146 records as books. Start with its 363 books plus identifiable long-form devotional/doctrinal/fathers works; keep sermons/hymns as their own resource types; exclude its Bible translations and Wikisource-provenance records.
sourceSpecificSorting.CatholicCorpus: Split 67772 documents into identifiable works/collections; prioritize patristics, theology, devotional, scholastic, hagiography and catechism; Scripture text stays outside Dawn translation; preserve per-file provenance/rights.
sourceSpecificSorting.IIIFHistoricalSources: Use manifests primarily to resolve editions, title pages/covers and readable scans; promote only when Work identity and reading rights are clear.

browseConsequence: 第二個 browse leaf 的主分類先使用八個 reader-facing families；語言、年代、傳統、資源類型與翻譯狀態作 facets。外文與中文自然混排，封面/書影優先；使用者先選作品，再決定原文/繁中/對照。
next: Run canonical thinning in source priority order: Open Christian Data identifiable books/long-form works -> PRDL eligible long-form titles -> CatholicCorpus identifiable works, while enriching covers/title pages and preserving cross-source deduplication.
